forms.negative: {祓|はら}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to exorcise, to purify, to cleanse of evil spirits
definitions.explanation: To perform a ritual purification to drive away evil spirits, impurities, or bad luck. Primarily associated with Shinto practices and traditional Japanese beliefs.

examples.japanese: {悪霊|あくりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祓|はら}う。
⟦{神主|かんぬし}→神主：16732_kannushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{穢|けが}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祓|はら}う⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The Shinto priest performed a purification ritual to cleanse the impurity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{厄|やく}→厄：11989_yaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祓|はら}って⟦もらい→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}った→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: At the new year, I had bad luck exorcised at the shrine and prayed for a safe year.

notes:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), う-ending.
- Negative: {祓|はら}わない
- Polite: {祓|はら}います
- Te-form: {祓|はら}って
- Past: {祓|はら}った

USAGE:
Distinct from the homophone ⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay; to sweep away). {祓|はら}う is specifically religious/ritual purification. The related noun {祓|はら}い or ⟦お{祓|はら}い→お祓い：15835_oharai⟧ refers to the purification ceremony itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪霊|あくりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祓|はら}う: to exorcise evil spirits
- {穢|けが}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祓|はら}う: to cleanse impurity
- ⟦{厄|やく}→厄：11989_yaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祓|はら}う: to ward off bad luck
- ⟦お{祓|はら}い→お祓い：15835_oharai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a purification ceremony
